renderer_contract.smoke_fixture_decision: keep the existing ignored GPU smoke as a compositor execution regression; exact PNG native and Web fixtures are separate because promotion requires fingerprints, candidate PNGs, imq JSON, command logs, and a review decision packet
renderer_contract.web_capture_decision: Playwright launches the pinned browser, but pixels come from the wasm-exported Arcweft player renderer reading back an Arcweft-owned rgba8unorm texture. The wasm fixture resolves typed Panel part style rules through ViewProgramResource::runtime_element_styles_with_style, attaches the fixture UiScene to a normal PreparedFrame, and renders via SharedRenderer::render_to_view. The browser test script only writes PNG/JSON artifacts. It does not call Playwright screenshot APIs or use DOM/CSS rendering as evidence.

status_classes.expected_skip: non-pinned local execution when exact evidence is not required; write fingerprint and do not fail
status_classes.environment_not_pinned: required exact job did not assert the pinned environment contract; fail milestone/release job
status_classes.environment_blocker: missing imq, pinned font probe, required browser/runtime, supported native adapter, or WebGPU availability; fail required job and upload fingerprint
status_classes.baseline_missing: candidate exists but promoted checked-in baseline is intentionally absent; no promotion is allowed until review decision is recorded
status_classes.baseline_drift: dimensions match and capture succeeds, but MSE/MAE exceed fixture thresholds
status_classes.hard_visual_regression: capture failure, imq failure, dimension mismatch, malformed PNG, forbidden route evidence, or missing required artifact after a pinned run

required_review_packet: review decision with source and candidate hashes
